children: Overview
Sweden air treatment firm's Q3 order intake rose 70%, led by Data Center Technologies and AirTech
Q3 net sales grew 18%, with AirTech and DCT contributing most to growth
Adjusted EBITA margin declined, pressured by DCT ramp-up and supply chain issues
Outlook
Munters maintains its outlook for 2026 unchanged
Company sees continued attractive long-term trends in key markets
Company says industry-wide supply chain constraints remain a factor going forward
Result Drivers
ORDER INTAKE - Co said strong demand in Data Center Technologies and AirTech drove 70% increase in order intake
AIRTECH AND DCT SALES - Net sales grew 18%, led by AirTech (Americas, APAC) and DCT (backlog execution, higher volumes)
DCT PROFITABILITY PRESSURE - DCT margin declined due to product mix changes, component shortages and ramp-up inefficiencies
